@graph.name: spectrafit-core Fe L2,3-edge case study
@graph.description: The measured Fe L2,3-edge X-ray absorption spectra of [FeCl4]- (Fe3+, d5) and [FeCl4]2- (Fe2+, d6) reproduced as Figure 3 of the spectrafit-core software metapaper, together with the scripts that fit them, the recorded fit results and the four constraint-hypothesis scenarios. This crate exists so the licence exception on the two spectra is machine-readable and not prose only: they are third-party data reproduced by permission and are NOT covered by the repository's MIT licence.

@graph.name: MIT, except where a file declares its own licence
@graph.description: This directory is not uniformly licensed. Every file is MIT-licensed, as the spectrafit-core repository is, EXCEPT those files that carry their own `license` property in this crate. Two do, and they are the only two: `FeCl4_d5.txt`, `FeCl4_d6.txt`. Resolve a file's licence from its own `license` property first, and fall back to MIT only where a file declares none.

@graph.name: Reproduced by permission; no onward reuse licence
@graph.description: Third-party measured data, reproduced and redistributed with the authors' permission. NOT covered by the MIT licence that covers the rest of this directory: that licence applies to the code. The permission is specific to this reproduction and redistribution and grants nothing onward -- the spectrafit-core repository records no reuse licence for these spectra. A third party wanting to use them should cite Wasinger et al. (2003) and seek permission from those authors.
@graph.citation: Wasinger EC, de Groot FMF, Hedman B, Hodgson KO, Solomon EI. L-edge X-ray absorption spectroscopy of non-heme iron sites: experimental determination of differential orbital covalency. J Am Chem Soc. 2003;125(42):12894-906. doi:10.1021/ja034634s
